subject: AWS co-sell: technical intro + account mapping — Acme Retail
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Margaret Ho <margaret@acme-retail.com>, James Reynolds <jreynolds@amazon.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, alex_martinez@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS co-sell: technical intro + account mapping — Acme Retail

Hi Margaret and James —

Thanks again for taking time to explore Redwood with Acme. Per our conversation at re:Invent, we think there’s a strong fit for Redwood’s managed inference offering to address Acme’s peak seasonal latency needs and data isolation requirements.

I’d like to propose a 45-minute joint planning call next week to align on: 
- current architecture and latency pain points (Acme infra)
- success criteria for a short POC (throughput / SLOs / cost targets)
- mapping of account roles (procurement, security, platform) and co-sell motion owners
- delivery timeline and next steps (who owns what)

Attaching a lightweight account map and our co-sell playbook for AWS to use as a starting point.

Proposed windows (Pacific): Tue 10–12, Wed 9–11, Thu 14–16. Tell me what works and we’ll lock it in — James, can you suggest an AWS seller/SE to join?

Agenda (draft):
1) Intros & context (5m)
2) Acme architecture + constraints (10m)
3) Redwood solution mapping + desired SLA (15m)
4) Roles/next steps + timeline (10m)

Looking forward — feel free to loop in procurement/security folks; I copied Alex and Karthik for technical and go-to-market alignment.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Acme_AWS_joint_account_map.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-playbook-aws-cosell.md (md)

Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: technical intro + account mapping — Acme Retail

Hi Laura —

Thanks — this looks great and timely. We’re interested in exploring a focused POC for checkout personalization that needs to hit a p95 latency under 120ms and support concurrent spikes during promotions.

I can do Wed 2027-05-05 09:30–10:15 PT or Thu 2027-05-06 14:30–15:15 PT. I’ve included Tom from procurement so he can flag any MSA/contract items early.

For the call, please include a short runbook of what we’ll need from our infra team (IAM roles, VPC peering, traffic shaping). If you already have a checklist, happy to take it beforehand.

Best,
Margaret Ho
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme Retail
margaret@acme-retail.com
